## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix

## Testing

- [ ] `cargo xfmt`
- [ ] `cargo xcheck`
- [ ] `cargo xtest`
- [ ] `cargo xtest-minimal`
- [ ] `cargo xlint`
- [ ] `cargo xexamples` if examples, facade features, or release readiness changed
- [ ] `cargo xdoc` if public docs or API surface changed

## Documentation

- [ ] README or crate docs updated if public behavior changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated if this should be part of the next release notes
- [ ] Issue or discussion intake labels and templates still match the new behavior

## Release and review notes

- [ ] Public API change reviewed
- [ ] Feature flags reviewed
- [ ] Release workflow impact reviewed
- [ ] Mirror provenance preserved when porting external contributions
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were routed through the private disclosure path when needed
